read_flow_middlebury: read a .flo optical flow file in Middlebury format and return a numpy array
read_pfm_file: read a PFM file and return the image data as a numpy array
write_flow_middlebury: write optical flow data to a .flo file in Middlebury format
read_flow_kitti: read a KITTI format optical flow PNG file and return flow and validity mask
read_generic_file: read images or flow files by auto-detecting format from file extension
